long_biography.plain_text:
Precision at SphericTrafalgar was measured in fractions of a micron. The West Sussex manufacturer made precision balls and metrology products, broadening its technical range by acquiring Spheric Engineering. When competitive pressure intensified, Nigel Edward Plaskett championed a practical response: invest in better machinery and concentrate on difficult components with fewer rivals.

That emphasis on industrial assets also appears in his connection to the Wiston site, where four substantial business units were approved around a common access road and extensive parking. His current company there records property letting alongside passenger transport, giving his public business footprint a mix of industrial real estate and operating activity.
